features.action: Saved during flight; loaded same process and new process on .8; retried exact .7 failure slot.
features.expected: Round counters and trajectory survive, projectile resolves after restart.
features.actual: .8 runs PASS, imported projectile restored and resumed to one hit.

features.action: Own material.graph commandlet sequence: enable/save, preset/apply/revert, invalid AI response, undo/redo/revert.
features.expected: Graph editing and preview work through native Qt window.
features.actual: Exit0; nativePreviewWindow=true, invalid AI text rejected, edits applied/reverted, undo/redo accepted.

features.action: Locked the .graph.json sidecar and requested revert; then retried after removing lock.
features.expected: Failed disk write preserves dirty in-memory graph; retry restores saved graph.
features.actual: Access-denied dialog appeared; failed operation kept dirty graph byte-equivalent to edited graph. Retry cleared dirty state and restored saved graph/HLSL. Undo/redo and invalid-AI rejection also passed.

features.action: Imported packed BLEND and used its two material slots on imported game projectile.
features.expected: Both source slots survive import and render on the item.
features.actual: Imported mesh renders distinct material regions in GPU capture; save snapshot holds two paths.

features.action: Used project.scene on own project: assigned explicit Material_1/Material_0 slot paths, undo/redo, saved/reopened scene.
features.expected: Two slots edit independently and persist.
features.actual: Saved scene contains the slot map; source IDs are retained.

features.action: Loaded exact .7 failure SaveGame JSON on .8 in a separate process.
features.expected: Previously failing Skeletal-derived projectile restores geometry, slot assignments and flight.
features.actual: PASS; exact old .7 snapshot has model /Game/Models/blend-suzanne-multiple/blend-suzanne-multiple.glb, slots 0=Material_1 and 1=Material_0, type Trash.MultiMaterialProjectile, flight elapsed=0.5; fresh .8 process loaded it and resumed to hit.

features.action: Captured same imported scene on/off castShadows; pixel-diffed GPU frames.
features.expected: Only shadow contribution changes.
features.actual: 667 pixel differences, bbox x484..543 y274..300; same imported model appears in both.

features.action: Imported textured multi-material Suzanne and captured it in flight.
features.expected: UV chart pattern readable on mesh.
features.actual: Textured model visible but too small for reliable chart-detail verdict.
